title: Phenylketonuria (PKU)
summary: Phenylketonuria means the body cannot break down phenylalanine, a building block found in protein. Without early care, it can build up and harm the brain.
inheritance_plain: It is inherited in an autosomal recessive way: a child is affected only if they get a changed copy of the PAH gene from both parents.
carrier_meaning: A carrier has one changed copy and is healthy.
disease_meaning: A person with two changed copies has PKU. Found early through newborn screening and managed with a special diet led by a specialist team, children can grow and learn well.
screening: Newborn screening in the UAE includes PKU.
